name: Sudan
summary: Drone war intensifies; Sudan says 97 drones were used in October attacks
state: A Sudanese government report says drone attacks killed 484 civilians and 176 soldiers between 15 Feb and 27 Oct, with 28 attacks using 97 drones in October, which it says were launched from Ethiopia; Ethiopia denies backing the RSF (Al Jazeera, 3 Nov). A drone strike in Nyala killed at least 21 on 26 Oct. No ceasefire talks were under way.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to Sudan.

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Deadly RSF drone strikes reveal divisions between Sudan and Ethiopia

why: The world's largest displacement and hunger crisis; regional spillover into Chad, South Sudan and the Red Sea.
drivers: SAF–RSF fighting, sieges, foreign arms supplies, aid access, famine.

rubric.alert: Major sieges or massacres reported, or famine spreading to new areas.
